name: Grimsby
doing: flying about town, as far as the Dorpskerk
thought: The spire is slightly off-center, which is either an error or a statement.

feeling.words: A sunbeam slants through the tiles, catching on the edge of a broken teacup. The scent of ink and old paper lingers where I left my pen. I’m not sure if I’m writing or just staring at the blank space.

place.name: the Dorpskerk
place.words: on the roof of the Dorpskerk
